decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy engineering core, and with no website trace since 2019 it is a likely candidate to cut so resources go to the core technology ventures.
Modular extensions complement the firm's waste-to-energy plant platform and cost little to keep offering, though they were only ever mentioned rather than featured.
WASTX Oil was a flagship launch with its own page and press release, addressing a large global problem in line with the firm's decentralized waste-to-energy strategy.
The plastic-to-fuel plant fits the firm's core mission and growing demand for plastic waste solutions, and it gained its own page by 2019.
